V, 48ᵈ</cite> <he>היי דין כ׳ מקורר וכ׳</he> which rock (when bored) will give forth water, and which &c., v. <cite ref="U01922"><he>שְׁרַבְרוּבֵי</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>כֵּיפִין</he>, <he>כֵּיפַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="K00606"><he>כֵּיפֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:13">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 19:11">Targ. I Kings XIX, 11</cite>.
Targ. Ps. CIV, 18; a. fr.—כיפי טבתא pearls, jewels.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 3:15">Targ. Prov. III, 15</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:13">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דנורא</he> (Ms. M. <he>טיפי</he>) fire-balls; <he>כ׳ דברדא</he> hail-stones.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:1:9">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43ᵈ</cite> <he>דאת אילין כ׳ …</he> thou must remove these stones.
Keth. 112ᵃ bot. מנשק כ׳ דעכו kissed the rocks (Rashi: corals) of the shore of Ptolemais (as sacred ground); Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ לכֵיפָתָא.
Ib. מתקל כֵּיפֵי weighed the stones (to demonstrate his appreciation of the sacred ground); a. fr.—Esp. כֵּיפֵי (v. supra) precious stones, jewelry (prob. amber, v. כֵּיפָה).
<cite ref="Eruvin 96b:14">Erub. 96ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 81b:8">Keth. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ תלא לה</he> has he jewelry suspended on it (his opinion)?, i.e. must his opinion absolutely be accepted?—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:3">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 35a:11">B. Mets. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>אפקיד כ׳ וכ׳</he> gave jewelry in trust &c.
Ib. הב לי כֵּיפַי (Ms. M. כֵּיפַאי) give me my jewelry back; a. e.—3) also כַּפָּא (cmp. גֵּיף, כַּף &c.) shore, border.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 7:12">Targ. Jud. VII, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 19:7">Targ. Is. XIX, 7</cite> <he>ככֵיפֵיה</he> (ed. Lag. <he>ככפיה</he>; ed. Wil. <he>בכיפי</he>, corr. acc.) like its shore.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 4a">Pes. 4ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02441"><he>אֲסִיסְנָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Nedarim 40a:11">Ned. 40ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נהרא מכֵּיפֵיה וכ׳</he> the Euphrates grows from (the waters coming down) its shores (not from rain); <cite ref="Shabbat 65b:10">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bekhorot 55b">Bekh. 55ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:1:1">Koh. R. to XI, 1</cite> <he>הוה מיטמר בכיף ימא</he> (some ed. <he>בכֵף</he>) was hiding himself at the sea-shore; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 8:7">Targ. Is. VIII, 7</cite> <he>כֵּיפוֹהִי</he>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 3:15">Targ. Josh. III, 15</cite> (some ed. <he>כַּפּוֹהִי</he>).—

Sabb. 65ᵇ מכֵּיפֵי some ed. (v. supra).—M. Kat. l. c. נשוק כ׳ … אהדדי the shores of … touched each other (the waters rising to the level of the shores; Rashi: the arches of the ruined bridges, v. infra).—4) arch, vault, v. כִּיפְתָא.—5) cap, v. כִּיפָּה.—6) bundle, sheaf, v. כַּפָּא.
